name: Custom Wall Art
summary: Original artwork designed for your wall, your brand and your light.
description: We start from your space — its dimensions, palette and purpose — and design artwork that belongs to it. Every piece is mocked up on a photo of your actual wall before production, so what you approve is what gets installed.
deliverables: Digital mockups on photos of your wall
Choice of canvas, acrylic, aluminum or fine-art paper
leadTime: Concepts in 5 working days, installed within 3–4 weeks of approval.

name: Murals & Large-Scale Installations
summary: Hand-finished murals and multi-panel installations that own the room.
description: For walls that deserve more than a frame — painted murals, printed wall coverings and layered multi-panel installations, engineered for the scale of atriums, corridors and full building façades.
deliverables: Site survey and wall preparation plan
leadTime: Survey within a week; most installations complete in 4–6 weeks.

name: Corporate Branding Walls
summary: Reception walls, culture walls and brand stories told in physical space.
description: Your office walls are your most-seen brand asset. We translate brand systems into dimensional logo walls, culture and values walls, timeline installations and acoustic art that photographs as well as it works.
leadTime: Concepts in a week; fabrication and install typically 3–5 weeks.

name: Calligraphy & Typography Studio
summary: Words as art — from sacred calligraphy to modern type compositions.
description: A dedicated studio practice for text-based art: contemporary calligraphy, verses and poetry, name pieces and motivational typography. Most pieces can be personalized with your own words, typography style and palette.
deliverables: Custom text, typography and palette options
leadTime: Proofs the same week; finished pieces in 2–3 weeks.

name: Space Curation & Installation
summary: A complete art program for your space — planned, sourced and installed.
description: For new builds and renovations: we plan art wall-by-wall across your floor plan, balance scale and palette across rooms, and handle delivery, leveling and mounting — one accountable team from plan to final walkthrough.
deliverables: Scale and palette planning per room
leadTime: Programming from your floor plan in 1–2 weeks; phased installs to suit your schedule.
